goal: Remove old tasks and course artifacts while preserving working workflow

in_scope: Delete prior task specs, task state, worklogs and run artifacts; remove historical curriculum, pilot course content, prior plans and source inventories. Keep workflow tooling, configurations, skills, review rules, templates, tests, and only this task records.
Update workflow entry points so they describe a fresh empty course and do not direct agents to removed historical artifacts.
out_of_scope: No new curriculum or lessons, no publication or merge without user approval. Preserve existing unrelated local changes in original worktree.

constraints: Explicit user instruction: remove old specs and outputs, retain workflow only. Git history remains available.
Use only exact enumerated workspace paths. Preserve workflow quality, independent review and full Primer coverage requirements.

definition_of_done.text: Old task records and course output artifacts removed, workflow dependencies and current task records retained, docs aligned.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run required validation and verify new task can be initialized and no prior records or generated course content remain.
